They don't even bother to read it!!
And there is no reason in the world why a telephone appointment can't be scheduled, they may be running early or late but at least you get an idea of the time, the policy of only ringing once and if you miss it you have to start again is ridiculous.
If you are lucky enough to get an appointment to see your GP you will probably have a 10-minute conversation with the receptionist who has rung you (the only way you'll ever speak to them) to arrange an appointment in about 3 weeks time only to then receive a text informing you that the appointment has been rearranged due to unforeseen circumstances and if you have a problem with it call reception - brilliant?!!
I've never been higher than 11th in the queue!!
Presumably they call this progress and more efficient?
